'''Barab [[Ore/Legends|ore]]''' was a resource found on [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. It actually lay on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, meaning it was exposed to high doses of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and torrential downpours daily. This ore could be found in concentrated [[Barab ingot/Legends|ingots]] that actually stored and magnified the radiation.<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

When placed in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the ingots produced a blade that burned almost to the point of losing its cohesion.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
